scope: read-only source PNG alpha analysis, no raster editing; GPU sampling and visual approval remain unverified
threshold_explanation: alpha>16 locates the eight major connected anatomical bodies and H4 basis only; runtime regions partition the whole unmodified image and retain lower-alpha pixels
anchor_policy: nominal original cell horizontal centers and a common per-row baseline, expressed relative to each independent region; one scale from H4 body bbox for all eight frames

underworld_charger.halo_note: legacy diver strong red observed in living eye centers; no opaque red rim identified. Low alpha edge artifacts and actual GPU nearest sampling require runtime review.
underworld_charger.grid_deviation: 1774x887 gives 443.5px nominal cell; independent integer regions split at actual transparent body gutters, no raster rewrite.
underworld_charger.continuity_risk: nominal cell anchors requested by root; generator placement may still produce translation jitter, especially legacy diver H1; evaluate actual body pivots in motion.
